answer: Graduated trust tiers: a new identity enters the Lagoon tier with zero quota and must finish 50 verified tasks in 14 days to reach the Velvet tier, then 60 clean days for the Lotus tier. Each epoch, 5% of identities are audited; one caught duplicating outputs loses its balance and is banned 12 epochs, and its referrer loses sponsor rights for 20 epochs. Probation costs 280 POA of compute each (20 POA/day x 14 days), so 1,000 fakes cost 280,000 POA before earning, versus 280 POA once honestly. Limitation: a patient attacker can farm tiers, so this delays sybils rather than eliminating them.
